Practice your parkour skills. ParkourCraft requires a good sense of timing and spatial awareness. Practice your jumps, vaults, and wall climbs to improve your skills and become a better player.

Don't be afraid to die. Death is a natural part of the game, and it's a great way to learn and improve your skills. Don't get discouraged if you die a few times – just keep trying and you'll eventually get the hang of it.
